doan_van.ten: Truyện — Kế hoạch quản lý tài chính
doan_van.noi_dung: Minh wants to buy a modern computer for his university studies next year. Right now, he cannot afford a new laptop because he spends most of his money on coffee and fast food. Last week, his older sister Linh helped him create a monthly budget. She explained that he must stop wasting money on useless things if he wants to achieve his goal. Minh checked his bank account and realised that he still owes some money to his friend. He decided to pay back his debt immediately. Now he works part-time at a local café to earn extra money every weekend. He puts most of his earnings into a savings account to earn interest. If he saves enough money, he will buy the computer by summer. Unless he saves carefully, he will not afford it. Linh promises that she will lend him some money if he needs it later. However, Minh prefers not to borrow anything or take a bank loan. He also wants to invest in online courses because education is always worth the price. Every month, he pays his electricity bill on time to keep good habits. If you do not plan your spending, you will waste your cash. Minh feels very happy because he is now in control of his money.

phat_am:
- **owe** /əʊ/ — chữ “w” câm, đọc như “oh”.
- **worth** /wɜːθ/ có /θ/ cuối, khác **work** /wɜːk/.
- **borrow** /ˈbɒrəʊ/ — trọng âm đầu.
luu_y:
**① Sau IF KHÔNG dùng will** (trong điều kiện loại 1).
❌ If it will rain, I will stay home. → ✅ **If it rains**, I will stay home.

> Tiếng Việt nói “Nếu trời sẽ mưa…” nghe được, tiếng Anh thì không.

**② Mệnh đề if đảo được lên trước hoặc sau — chỉ khác dấu phẩy:**

- *If it rains, I’ll stay home.* (có phẩy)
- *I’ll stay home if it rains.* (không phẩy)

**③ unless = if… not.**
*Unless you save money, you won’t buy it.* = *If you don’t save money, you won’t buy it.*

> ❌ Unless you don’t save… — thừa phủ định.

**④ Thay will bằng modal khác được:** *If you need help, you **can** call me. / you **should** ask.*

**⑤ Nhóm từ tiền bạc dễ nhầm:**

- **borrow** = mượn (lấy vào) · **lend** = cho mượn (đưa ra)

> *Can I **borrow** your pen?* / *Can you **lend** me your pen?*

- **spend money ON** something · **spend time V-ing**
- **afford** luôn đi với can/could: *I **can’t afford** it.* ❌ I don’t afford.
- **worth + V-ing**: *It’s worth buying.*

**⑥ money không đếm được** (nhắc lại): ❌ moneys, ❌ many money → **much money**.
meo:
- Điều kiện loại 1 nhớ bằng nhịp: **“if + hiện tại, will + tương lai”** — hai vế không bao giờ cùng will.
- **borrow ↔ lend:** borrow là **mượn về** (hướng vào mình), lend là **cho mượn** (hướng ra). Nhớ “**l**end = **l**eave your hand”.
- **unless = if not** — thay thử vào câu, nếu nghĩa vẫn đúng là dùng chuẩn.
